world_seed.visual_direction: oxidized teal membranes and ivory ceramic hardware

premise: Inside a biomechanical lung orbiting a gas giant, breathable air is a traded commodity and physical room access shifts with the pressure tides.
simulation_objective: Manage the flow of oxygen futures while navigating the shifting physical connections of the lung's lobes.
exploration_focus: dynamic room connectivity based on inflation cycles
visual_style: Top-down pixel art, oxidized teal, ivory ceramic, saffron threads, charcoal shadows.

social_rules: Breath is credit; to waste air is to steal from the collective.
The High Broker's word is law during the inhalation phase.
No physical violence is permitted on the Exchange Floor; all disputes are settled by trade.
Filter workers must be given right-of-way in the Mucus Filter.
player_entry_points: Arriving as a new Breath Broker on the Exchange Floor.
Waking up as a Filter Technician in the Mucus Filter.
Starting as a Guard at the Primary Bronchus gate.
conflict_hooks: A sudden pressure drop threatens to close the path to the dorms.
Thorne is accused of hoarding pure oxygen while the workers suffocate.
A map is discovered showing a secret valve that can drain the entire lung.
